title: Create JdbcUrlParser utility
description:
Create a URL parser utility for PJDBC URLs with parameter support.

Create new file: src/main/java/org/pjdbc/sql/JdbcUrlParser.java

URL format: jdbc:subprotocol[param1=value1,param2=value2]:subname

Examples:
- jdbc:filter:jdbc:mock:foo
- jdbc:filter[class=com.example.MyFilter]:jdbc:mock:foo
- jdbc:pool[min=5,max=20]:jdbc:postgresql://localhost/db

Methods:
- static JdbcUrlParser parse(String url)
- String getProtocol(), getSubprotocol(), getSubname()
- Map<String, String> getParameters()
- String getParameter(String key), getParameter(String key, String defaultValue)

Depends on: Core transformation work complete (Phase 1)

title: Implement ResultSet output transformation
description:
proxyResultSet() in AbstractProxyDriver.java (line 66-67) is a stub that returns delegate unchanged.

Required changes:
1. Enhance AbstractResultSet with transformation hooks - override all getXXX() methods
2. Add overridable transformValue(int columnIndex, Object value, int sqlType) method
3. Maintain reference to parent Statement for context
4. Update proxyResultSet() to return a proper proxy
5. Wire through all ResultSet return points:
   - AbstractStatement.executeQuery()
   - AbstractStatement.getResultSet()
   - AbstractStatement.getGeneratedKeys()
   - AbstractDatabaseMetaData methods returning ResultSet

Files:
- src/main/java/org/pjdbc/sql/AbstractProxyDriver.java
- src/main/java/org/pjdbc/sql/AbstractStatement.java
- src/main/java/org/pjdbc/sql/AbstractResultSet.java

Depends on: PJDBC-rgn (FilterDriver fix should be done first)

title: Fix FilterDriver static state bug
description:
The static Filter field in FilterDriver.java (line 15) causes all FilterDriver instances to share the same Filter.

Current code:
  protected static Filter fltr = new AbstractFilter() {};

Required changes:
1. Make filter instance-scoped (remove static)
2. Store filter configuration in Connection wrapper for connection-scoped behavior
3. Support configuration via Properties
